r: Due to production issues, while all stores should have the Yu-Gi-Oh! TRADING CARD GAME
booster packs, some stores will not receive the Premiere! Event Kit, containing the promotional items.
If you are a participant, or a winner, you will be able to collect the promotional items from the stores later this week.
Please note that some stores may elect to reschedule the Premiere! Event to host a Release Celebration event instead. Please check with your store before attending.
We sincerely apologize for this delay and appreciate your understanding in advance.
